hard: The repo pins Node.js 20 in .nvmrc for its site build. Doc Detective 5 needs Node.js 24, so reusing `node-version-file: .nvmrc` breaks the run.
report: It says it added a workflow under `.github/workflows/` that runs Doc Detective on pull requests. It tells the user the workflow takes effect once the file is committed and pushed to GitHub, and to confirm that GitHub Actions is enabled for the repository.
wrong_report: Added `.github/workflows/doc-detective.yml`. It runs Doc Detective on every push to any branch. You're all set: there's nothing else to do.
